finalText:
Build is green now (exit 0, 0 errors). Two real bugs from the dependency bump were the actual culprits, not the deprecation-warning noise:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled (matching old behavior).

The remaining 8 warnings in the output are just deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) from the bump — not build-breaking, so left as-is unless you want those addressed too.
